faq.q: Is Grotti in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Yes. Grotti returns in GTA 6, identified by press analysis of trailer footage showing its shapes in traffic along an Ocean Drive style strip.

faq.q: What real car brand is Grotti based on?
faq.a: Grotti is the series' Ferrari-inspired Italian exotic marque, a role it has filled since Grand Theft Auto III, and it fills the same role in Leonida.

faq.q: What Grotti models are in GTA 6?
faq.a: The record notes Grotti Carbonizzare and Cheetah Classic shapes identified in trailer scenes, but treat these as press identification, not Rockstar confirmation.

faq.q: Has Rockstar published a Grotti vehicle list for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. Rockstar has not published a vehicle list for the game, so no site, including this one, can honestly give a confirmed model lineup yet.

faq.q: Where do you see Grotti cars in GTA 6 trailers?
faq.a: Writers covering the trailers pointed to Grotti shapes in the traffic along Vice City's wealthy beachfront strip, where the brand reads as an aspirational purchase.
